Catalog number : I00036 Uniform title: Navakuṇḍavidhi Manuscript : IFP manuscript bundle RE32408 Description: RE32408 Navakuṇḍavidhi. This bundle primarily focuses on the Navakuṇḍavidhi and the Pañcakuṇḍavidhi rituals elaborately. It gives the detailed procedures of various types of Agnikārya performed in the Yāgaśālā during pratiṣṭhā ceremonies, with reference to the Sahasrāgama. It also includes the chapters on the Aṣṭabandhanam (the adhesive ritual for installing deities) and Śivaliṅgapratiṣṭhāvidhi from the Kāmikāgama, explaining the significant aspects of consecration rituals. The final section contains the Āṟupattumūṟṟuvar-dhyānas (meditative verses on the 63 Śaiva saints), though this portion appears incomplete.
